title: Renew your permit — and keep it valid
whatHappens: Your residence permit is usually valid for one year and must be renewed — it doesn't renew automatically. To renew, you show you still meet the financial and housing requirements, and that you're actually making academic progress: at least 1 exam passed for your first renewal, at least 2 for every renewal after that.
whoDecides: The Questura, based on the documents and academic records you submit.
timing: Start the renewal process before your current permit expires — there's no grace period built in.
whatCanGoWrong: Falling behind on exams doesn't just affect your degree timeline — it can put your legal right to stay at risk.
whatKimereDoes: We track your renewal dates and help you assemble the file each year, so this becomes routine instead of a yearly scramble.
